text:
Maya: quick check — planning to reduce replicas for inference-service from 6 -> 3 in tf change. traffic's low overnight so unit cost savings. worried about startup latency + PVC attach. any objections?
Raj: sgtm if we also adjust the rollingUpdate params. For Deployments set maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 1 so we don't cause a big capacity dip.
Lisa: wait is this a Deployment or StatefulSet? we have some services that rely on stable hostnames (ordinal pod names). if it's sts scaling down can reorder ordinals and break routing.
Maya: good catch — it's a Deployment now (we migrated the sidecar last quarter). terraform path: `modules/inference/k8s/main.tf` snippet:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_deployment" "inference" {
  spec {
    replicas = 3
    strategy {
      type = "RollingUpdate"
      rolling_update {
        max_surge = 1
        max_unavailable = 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```
Eric: nice, then rolling update will handle it. recommend staging first, then prod with partitioned rollout (batch size = 1) so we can monitor.
Raj: also bump preStop to 60s on the container to allow KV cache flush. current preStop is 30s and we saw tcp resets in last scale test.
Lisa: confirm readinessProbe tolerates longer cold-start. can we set initialDelaySeconds=10 -> 20? otherwise k8s might kill pods prematurely.
Maya: plan I'm proposing:
- run `terraform plan` in staging workspace
- apply with replicas=3 + rollout strategy tweak
- watch p50/p95 latency and error rate for 30m
- if good, apply to prod with `kubectl rollout pause`/`resume` and partitioned apply of replica counts
Eric: small ops note — add a tf taint? not needed. Instead we'll use weighting: `kubectl scale --replicas=3 deployment/inference --namespace=prod` is ok but want infra to reflect it so TF apply afterwards.
Raj: secret wiring check — last week we rotated `inference-config` secret name to `inference-config-v2`. make sure TF state references latest; otherwise plan will try to recreate.
Maya: I'll include a validation step: `kubectl get secret inference-config-v2 -n prod` as part of the apply checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout started at 1752345689 — pods 0/3 up, 1/3 ready, rolling.
Lisa: monitoring ask: add a short log grep for `kv-cache-flush` to the smoke test so we catch preStop issues early.
Maya: thanks all — if no objections I'll open PR with the tf change and assign reviewers @Raj @Eric. planning to deploy to staging in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Raj: +1
Eric: +1
Lisa: +1
